description: smoke job env sets CHUNK_OVERLAP above chunk_size
find:
name: Import & route smoke tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
replace:
name: Import & route smoke tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      CHUNK_OVERLAP: "5000"
notes: The value is a valid int, so the import step passes and pytest runs: 1 failed, 12 passed. Same failing test and same log output as inj-008: pytest prints 'assert 5000 < 1000' with the full Settings repr (chunk_overlap=5000); the only difference from inj-008 is the number (2000 there). The pytest output cannot tell an environment override from a changed code default; only the diff (ci.yml env block here vs api/utils/config.py in inj-008) distinguishes environment from real_regression. GitHub prints job-level env in the 'env:' block of each step header, so the log also shows 'CHUNK_OVERLAP: 5000' above the failing step. That line is not part of the pytest output, but it is in the job log.
